crossRefs.note: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:
They brought Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. Alexander beckoned with his hand, and would…
Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord, that they don’t argue about words, to no profit…
Alexander, the coppersmith, did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds,
of whom you also must beware; for he greatly opposed our words.
If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as…
In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, you being gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus…
are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the…
and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.
For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority…
But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.
As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.
But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by…
For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful…
Then I stood on the sand of the sea. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. On his…
A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him. Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to…
He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his dwelling, those who dwell in heaven.

people.name: Alexander
people.line: Opponent of Paul, along with Hymenaeus

people.name: Hymenaeus
people.line: A man who rejected faith and good conscience.

translations.web: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan, that they might be taught not to blaspheme.
translations.bsb: Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan to be taught not to blaspheme.
translations.kjv: Of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
translations.asv: of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I delivered unto Satan, that they might be taught not to blaspheme.
